title: Review of Distribution Methods for Budget 2020 Grocery Vouchers
what_it_is: Review of Distribution Methods for Budget 2020 Grocery Vouchers

sections.label: Grocery Voucher Theft and Arrests
sections.summary: About 150,000 $150 Grocery Vouchers were mailed to eligible Singaporeans in October, with 229 sets reported stolen and 55 arrests made by 28 October 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: About 150,000 sets of Grocery Vouchers, each worth $150, were mailed out via tracked registered mail to eligible Singaporeans in October this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Two hundred and twenty-nine sets, or less than 0.2%, have been reported as stolen as of 28 October 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Police are investigating the reported theft cases and have made 55 arrests as of 28 October 2020.

sections.label: Voucher Replacement and Delivery Mode
sections.summary: Stolen vouchers were voided and replacements issued, and registered mail was chosen over digital vouchers after weighing health, convenience and security.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The small number of vouchers reported as stolen have been voided and replacement vouchers are being issued to eligible recipients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: On the choice of the delivery mode, we balanced between public health constraints amidst COVID-19, reasonable convenience for the recipients and security.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: If digital vouchers were used, more time and effort would have been needed to first provide appropriate digital interfaces, before the recipients can receive the intended support with their household expenses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: That said, as digital literacy improves among older Singaporeans, we may be able to consider digital vouchers for this group in future.

sections.label: Registered Mail for Convenience
sections.summary: The grocery vouchers were sent via registered mail for optimal convenience to the intended recipients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: On balance, we sent the grocery vouchers via registered mail for optimal convenience to the intended recipients.

sections.label: Voucher Features Against Theft
sections.summary: Each voucher has unique features that identify the intended recipient and trace the voucher to specific locations and transaction times.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To mitigate theft and fraud, each voucher has unique features which enable us to identify the intended recipient and trace any voucher to specific locations and time of transaction.
